title: Parity tools that still point at the deleted v2 estate
body:
From cc's lane:

- `read_claim_probe.sh:45` defaults to `bin/intent`.
- `coverage_map.sh` refuses at HEAD.
- `fixture_probe.sh`'s canaries are deleted.
- `of_n_population.sh:249-252` contradicts `runner_roster_check.sh:255`.

Line numbers as at the audit.

Found by hv's estate-wide doc audit of 2026-09-11 (the audit's orders are in `intent/history/20260911-doc-audit.md`), where it is described as built. Carried in `intent/wip.md` as an unruled defect until 2026-09-13, when that file was leaned and every open defect became an issue. Not worked until hv rules it; a ruled one gets a lane.


CLOSED 2026-09-14 (dc), all four, on vc's ruling:
- `read_claim_probe.sh` defaults `BIN` to `native/rust/target/release/intent`.
- `coverage_map.sh` and `fixture_probe.sh` are NOT defects. Both run against the measured v2 revision, and at HEAD, where `tests/` and the canaries are gone, they refuse by design. `fixture_probe.sh` is the declared input of `gen_register.sh`, which runs it under `ROOT="$WT"`, a worktree at the measured rev re-derivable by `git worktree add <dir> <sha>`. `coverage_map.sh` reads `tests/` relative to where it runs, so its rev was implicit; it now declares it in a header line in `gen_register.sh`'s form. Both stay.
- `of_n_population.sh`'s REACH item 3 now agrees with `runner_roster_check.sh`: the roster lists every `*.sh` under `parity/tools` by `git ls-files`, whatever the name, so `unrostered` means unclassified, not "not gated".
